title: Finch Circle Card Status Floor — Moving a Membership to the Tier a Marlowe & Finch Card Grants
content:
## The rule

When the customer holds a Marlowe & Finch card account in active status whose card grants a higher Finch Circle tier than the membership record shows (Finch Circle Gold for a Store Card Elite or a Platinum Mastercard, Finch Circle Platinum for a World Elite Mastercard), the membership is moved to that floor tier as a card floor, and the change posts no points bonus.

| Card account in active status | Floor tier it grants in the Finch Circle Loyalty Program |
|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Store Card Elite | Finch Circle Gold |
| Marlowe & Finch Platinum Mastercard | Finch Circle Gold |
| Marlowe & Finch World Elite Mastercard | Finch Circle Platinum |

**Observable effect.** The membership record shows the floor tier, its latest tier change is recorded as a card floor dated the change date, and one alteration credit top-up grant for the current benefit year is posted with the change, raising the alteration credit balance. No points bonus is posted.

## Recording the card floor: `apply_card_status_floor_f82dd75f`

**Capability.** Customer care moves a Finch Circle membership to the tier granted by the member's Marlowe & Finch card status (a card floor) and posts the alteration credit top-up that goes with the change. The membership's tier becomes the given tier, its latest tier change is recorded as a card floor dated today, its status stays as given, one alteration credit grant marked as a tier top-up for the current benefit year is posted with the given amount, and the alteration credit balance rises by that amount. No points bonus is posted. The member sees the new tier and the higher alteration credit at once.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: customer care unlocks `apply_card_status_floor_f82dd75f` and then calls it.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | What it is | Format and values |
|---|---|---|
| `membership_id` | the reference number of the Finch Circle membership being changed, as returned by the membership lookup | identifier |
| `status` | the membership status as the membership record shows it, which the membership keeps | one of `active` (open for earning and redemption), `suspended` (frozen for a program review), `closed` (cancelled or terminated) |
| `new_tier` | the official name of the tier the membership moves to | one of Finch Circle Member (entry tier), Finch Circle Silver (second tier), Finch Circle Gold (third tier), Finch Circle Platinum (fourth tier), Finch Circle Diamond (fifth tier), Finch Circle Icon (top tier) |
| `top_up_amount` | the alteration credit added for the current benefit year | USD, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 when no credit is added |

**Return.** A receipt with: `status` ("applied" when the tier change and the top-up were recorded); `membership_id`; `new_tier` (official tier name now held); `last_tier_change_type` (always `card_floor`); `last_tier_change_date` (YYYY-MM-DD); `grant_id` (reference number of the alteration credit grant entry); `top_up_amount` (USD, 2 decimal places); `alteration_credit_balance` (the new alteration credit balance, USD, 2 decimal places).

## Points of judgement

- A customer with an active World Elite Mastercard and a membership record showing Finch Circle Gold is moved to Finch Circle Platinum as a card floor.
- A customer with an active Store Card Elite whose membership record already shows Finch Circle Diamond holds no higher tier from the card; no card floor arises.
- The card floor posts no tier bonus points.
